newsitem.title: USA: JLG to restructure, sees lower EPS, revs.
newsitem.headline: JLG to restructure, sees lower EPS, revs.

text.p: JLG Industries Inc said Wednesday its earnings per share for the fourth quarter, ending July 31, 1997, will be below previous expectations and below last year's fourth quarter earnings of $0.30 per share, due primarily to recent order softness and increasingly competitive market conditions.

The company also announced a restructuring plan, including downsizing, designed to counteract the unfavorable market conditions. Under the restructuring, JLG said it plans cut the workforce in September by 850 employees, or 30 percent.

The plan will involve provisions of about $7 million, of which about $2 million will be taken in the fourth quarter; the remaining one-time costs will be taken against fiscal 1998's first quarter, the company said.
JLG said it expects sales during fiscal 1998 to be below 1997's record level, and closer to 1996 revenues.
In fiscal 1998, earnings per share are expected to reach only the lower end of the current range of analysts' expectations, which is about $0.68 to $1.35 per share, it said.
The company said it expects its performance during fiscal 1998 to improve as the year progresses.
